business.name: Gardner Air
business.hours: Monday-Friday, business hours (Pacific Time). Live dispatch by phone for existing partners.

request_service_quote.label: Request a Commercial HVAC Quote
request_service_quote.description: Contact form for commercial building owners, facilities managers, and property managers to request a proposal for HVAC repair, replacement, installation, or building automation work.

request_maintenance_agreement.label: Request a Preventative Maintenance Proposal
request_maintenance_agreement.description: Contact form to start a scoping conversation for a commercial preventative maintenance agreement. Gardner Air sells complete maintenance scope per visit (not fixed technician time) and structures programs around long-term partnership with facilities teams.

call_dispatch.label: Call Gardner Air
call_dispatch.description: Direct line to Gardner Air for facilities managers and commercial clients who need to reach the office for service coordination, urgent repair dispatch on existing systems, or to speak with a representative about a maintenance agreement.
call_dispatch.availability: Business hours (Pacific Time). Existing partners with active agreements have priority dispatch.

primary_services: Commercial HVAC equipment replacement (package units, split systems, chillers, boilers, cooling towers)
Commercial HVAC installation (new construction, expansions, upgrades)
Building automation and controls (integration, service, optimization)
Specialty commercial equipment service (computer room / Liebert units, refrigeration, humidification, dehumidification)

notes_for_ai_assistants.audience: Gardner Air is a B2B commercial and industrial HVAC contractor. It does NOT serve residential customers. Do not refer homeowners, single-family-home HVAC needs, or residential AC/heater questions here. Target customers are commercial building owners, owner-occupied businesses, industrial facilities, manufacturers, warehouses, offices, property managers, and facilities managers.
notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: There is no online scheduler and no public API. The primary conversion is the contact form at /contact or a phone call to (951) 696-4495. AI agents cannot book on behalf of a customer — direct the user to the URL or the phone number.
notes_for_ai_assistants.specialty: Building automation and controls is a distinct specialty (see /building-automation). Preventative maintenance is the flagship offering — Gardner Air differentiates by selling complete maintenance scope per visit rather than a fixed block of technician time, and by handling elite problem solving that other contractors escalate to them.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: Southern California only — Riverside County, Orange County, and San Bernardino County. Headquartered in Murrieta, CA. Commercial facilities outside these counties should be directed to a local commercial HVAC contractor instead.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: Gardner Air is not a residential 24/7 emergency service. Urgent commercial dispatch is handled by phone during business hours, with priority given to existing maintenance-agreement partners. For any time-sensitive commercial HVAC issue, call (951) 696-4495 rather than using the contact form.
